5.text: comparison with the other tribes of this country, the Chukchee are considerably

6.text: more decent. Among the Russian and Russianized natives throughout the

7.text: whole northeast, from the Lena River to Kamchatka, hardly any girl remains

8.text: virgin until her marriage. Most of them begin sexual life with the first traces
